rules.rule: Simulated and real data must be stored in separate directories
Every dataset must have explicit origin metadata
rules.implementation: origin field in all manifests and feature registries

rules.rule: Future experiments must declare data origin
Mixing simulated and real data must fail closed
Phase 31-R simulated results must not be modified

validation_tests.test: Verify simulated data directory is separate from real data
validation_tests.rationale: Simulated data is inline in Phase 31-R script. Real data is in data/normalized/macro/fred_treasury/

validation_tests.test: Verify real data has origin metadata
validation_tests.rationale: All real data files have provider='fred_csv' and snapshot_id='DS-32R'
